sections.title: باب 4 — متن (12)

paras.text: … deprivation, injustice and partiality, and instead of conflicts being resolved, they become more complicated and insoluble. At this time America, Britain, Germany, France, Russia and other world powers are not playing a proper role for world peace. On the contrary these countries keep exploiting weak countries. The weakness and discouraging performance of world institutions, the helplessness and partiality of these institutions, and the violation of international law by great powers also become the cause of international problems. If the two world wars and the Cold War between America and the former Soviet Union are analysed, it becomes clear that the clash between basically ideological views was the cause of world destruction. America tried to promote the capitalist system, while the Soviet Union wanted to spread the socialist system. The war of 1950-53 between North Korea and South Korea was on the basis of ideological difference. In Afghanistan the interference of Russia too was because of spreading the ideology. Arms race too has been a cause of wars. Among the causes of both world wars the arms race is included. Today there is an atomic arms race between countries which can become the cause of a great world destruction.

For example, when countries come into the field with truthfulness and with honesty make this resolve that problems are to be solved in every circumstance, then there is no reason why problems would not be solved. Every work, when done with spirit, courage and wisdom, certainly shows results. But when the people come into the field with resolve, feeling, truthfulness, wisdom and planning, problems get solved. At the world level, take the Kashmir issue. Apparently, under world pressure, India becomes ready for high-level negotiations with Pakistan and several rounds of negotiations also take place, but because India does not come into the field with truthfulness …

paras.text: For the resolution of international problems, conciliation too is an effective path. Through conciliation, disagreement between opposing groups or people ends and a friendly environment is established. Resolving a conflict between people, groups or states and making them friends again is called conciliation. In the year 1948 the white rulers came to power in South Africa. In South Africa racism, racial discrimination and inequality existed as a custom. After 1948 racial discrimination was given legal protection. A regular government programme was started to establish the supremacy of the whites. The government of the whites declared economic exploitation, political supremacy and social privilege lawful. Unequal education, special protection for the whites, discrimination in employment and residential separation were ensured. In the year 1950 a law was passed fixing separate residential areas for the four basic racial groups, i.e. white, black, coloured (neither black nor white) and Asian people. Access of blacks to white areas and mutual marriage of both were declared unlawful. Blacks were arrested for moving about in cities for more than 72 hours without permission. Lakhs of people were arrested, and grave violations of human rights were committed. To investigate the cruelties committed on the basis of the racial discrimination policy of the previous government, the government of Nelson Mandela established in April 1995 the Truth and Reconciliation Commission. In 1996 this seventeen-member commission started work under the leadership of Bishop Desmond Tutu. In the commission all generations were given representation. The aim of the commission was to hear the people who had been victims of oppression and racism from 1960 to 1994. The commission also thought about pardoning those people who had confessed to committing excesses on a racial basis. The aim of the commission was to redress the oppressed and to block the path of such events occurring in future, and as a kind of payment to those people who had become victims of racial discrimination. Those who adopted truthfulness and those who confessed were shown to the people directly. The commission obtained innumerable solid testimonies of unjust, unequal and racial discrimination against the previous rulers. The commission heard the stories of fifteen thousand oppressed, and in 1998 presented its report. In the report racial discrimination was identified …

Conciliation

For the resolution of international problems, conciliation too is an effective path. Through conciliation, disagreement between opposing groups or people ends and a friendly environment is established. Resolving a conflict between people, groups or states and making them friends again is called conciliation. In the year 1948 the white rulers came to power in South Africa. In South Africa racism, racial discrimination and inequality existed as a custom. After 1948 racial discrimination was given legal protection. A regular government programme was started to establish the supremacy of the whites. The government of the whites declared economic exploitation, political supremacy and social privilege lawful. Unequal education, special protection for the whites, discrimination in employment and residential separation were ensured. In the year 1950 a law was passed fixing separate residential areas for the four basic racial groups, i.e. white, black, coloured (neither black nor white) and Asian people. Access of blacks to white areas and mutual marriage of both were declared unlawful. Blacks were arrested for moving about in cities for more than 72 hours without permission. Lakhs of people were arrested, and grave violations of human rights were committed. To investigate the cruelties committed on the basis of the racial discrimination policy of the previous government, the government of Nelson Mandela established in April 1995 the Truth and Reconciliation Commission. In 1996 this seventeen-member commission started work under the leadership of Bishop Desmond Tutu. In the commission all generations were given representation. The aim of the commission was to hear the people who had been victims of oppression and racism from 1960 to 1994. The commission also thought about pardoning those people who had confessed to committing excesses on a racial basis. The aim of the commission was to redress the oppressed and to block the path of such events occurring in future, and as a kind of payment to those people who had become victims of racial discrimination. In the same way, on the Palestine issue, through America’s insistence several negotiating rounds took place between the Palestinian and Israeli leadership, but because Israel does not want to solve the issue from the heart and is not serious and truthful in the negotiations, the issue is dragging on. Therefore states will have to show seriousness and truthfulness for the solution of problems.

Conciliation

For the resolution of international problems, conciliation too is an effective path. Through conciliation, disagreement between opposing groups or people ends and a friendly environment is established. Resolving a conflict between people, groups or states and making them friends again is called conciliation. In the year 1948 the white rulers came to power in South Africa. In South Africa racism, racial discrimination and inequality existed as a custom. After 1948 racial discrimination was given legal protection. A regular government programme was started to establish the supremacy of the whites. The government of the whites declared economic exploitation, political supremacy and social privilege lawful. Unequal education, special protection for the whites, discrimination in employment and residential separation were ensured. In the year 1950 a law was passed fixing separate residential areas for the four basic racial groups, i.e. white, black, coloured (neither black nor white) and Asian people. Access of blacks to white areas and mutual marriage of both were declared unlawful. Blacks were arrested for moving about in cities for more than 72 hours without permission. Lakhs of people were arrested, and grave violations of human rights were committed. To investigate the cruelties committed on the basis of the racial discrimination policy of the previous government, the government of Nelson Mandela established in April 1995 the Truth and Reconciliation Commission. In 1996 this seventeen-member commission started work under the leadership of Bishop Desmond Tutu. In the commission all generations were given representation. The aim of the commission was to hear the people who had been victims of oppression and racism from 1960 to 1994. The commission also thought about pardoning those people who had confessed to committing excesses on a racial basis. The aim of the commission was to redress the oppressed and to block the path of such events occurring in future, and as a kind of payment to those people who had become victims of racial discrimination. Those who adopted truthfulness and those who confessed were shown to the people directly. (نہ کالے نہ سفید) اور ایشیائی لوگوں کیلئے جدا رہائشی علاقے مقرر کرنے کا قانون منظور کیا گیا۔ سیاہ فاموں کیلئے سفید فاموں کے علاقے تک رسائی اور دونوں کا باہمی شادی غیر قانونی قرار دیا گیا۔ سیاہ فاموں کیلئے شہروں میں بغیر اِجازت کے 72 گھنٹے سے زیادہ گھومنے پھرنے پر اِنہیں گرفتار کیا جاتا تھا۔ لاکھوں لوگوں کو گرفتار کیا گیا اور اِنسانی حقوق کی سنگین خلاف ورزیاں کی گئیں۔ سابقہ حکومت کی نسلی اِمتیاز کی پالیسی اور اِس بنیاد پر کی گئیں مظالم کی تحقیقات کیلئے نیلسن منڈیلا کی حکومت نے اپریل 1995ء میں سچائی اور تصفیہ کمیشن (Truth and Reconcilliation Commission) قائم کیا۔ 1996ء میں اِس سترہ رُکنی کمیشن نے پادری ڈیسمانڈ ٹوٹو کی قیادت میں کام شروع کیا۔ کمیشن میں تمام نسلوں کو نمائندگی دی گئی تھی۔ کمیشن کا مقصد 1960ء سے 1994ء تک مظلوم اور نسل پرستی کے شکار یا نشانہ بننے والے لوگوں کو سننا تھا۔ کمیشن نے اُن لوگوں کو معافی دینے کے بارے میں بھی سوچنا تھا جنہوں نے نسلی بنیاد پر زیادتی کرنے کا اعتراف کیا تھا۔ اُن لوگوں کو بھی بدلے کے طور پر کچھ دینا تھا جو نسلیت کے شکار بن چکے تھے۔ اِس کمیشن کا مقصد مظلوموں کی دادرسی کرنا اور مستقبل میں ایسے واقعات رونما ہونے کا راستہ روکنا بھی تھا۔ سچائی اختیار کرنے والوں اور اعتراف کرنے والوں کو براہِ راست عوام کو دکھایا گیا۔ کمیشن کو سابقہ حکمرانوں کے نامناسب،
